article_content: The judge overseeing the defamation lawsuit against Casey Anthony has recused himself, creating uncertainty about whether Anthony must undergo a deposition days after her scheduled July 17 jail release. Judge Jose Rodriguez transferred the case to Judge Lisa Munyon following a brief hearing. Zenaida Fernandez Gonzalez's lawsuit originates from Anthony's 2008 false claim that Gonzalez kidnapped her daughter Caylee. Authorities disproved the nanny narrative but located Gonzalez, who reports enduring death threats and life disruption due to the allegations. Despite her July 5 murder acquittal, Anthony faces a civil deposition request. Her legal team contends she's too emotionally drained to participate, while Gonzalez's attorneys emphasize Anthony remains under subpoena. Anthony's counsel warns of Fifth Amendment invocations if compelled to testify.

Případ nyní povede soudkyně Lisa Munyonová. Občanskoprávní žalobu podala Zenaida Fernández Gonzálezová kvůli falešným tvrzením Anthony z roku 2008 o únosu dcery Caylee. Během vyšetřování se nepotvrdila existence chůvy, ale našla se Gonzálezová, která kvůli nařčení čelila výhrůžkám smrtí a narušení života. I přes osvobození od obvinění z vraždy 5. července musí Anthony řešit civilní spor. Její právník Charles Greene argumentuje emocionálním vyčerpáním po procesu, zatímco právní tým Gonzálezové trvá na výslechu. Anthony hrozí uplatněním práva proti sebeobviňování.

article_content: (CNN) -- Despite calls to resign after admitting to past crack cocaine use, Toronto Mayor Rob Ford stated Tuesday he will remain in office and seek re-election in October 2014. 'I was elected to serve and will continue doing so,' Ford declared during a press conference. 'In our democracy, I want Toronto residents to decide my fate next year.' Ford acknowledged smoking crack cocaine in 2013 during what he described as a 'drunken episode,' but denied addiction. 'I've embarrassed my city and deeply regret it,' he said, vowing his mistakes 'will never recur.' Pressure intensified last week when Toronto Police Chief William Blair confirmed investigators obtained a video allegedly showing Ford using drugs. This follows May 2013 reports by Gawker and Toronto Star about a purported drug-use recording. City Councillor John Filion, who proposed limiting Ford's powers, stated: 'The mayor should step aside and reassess his priorities.' Ford claimed even family members were unaware of his drug use. A 465-page police report details video evidence recovered from a drug investigation. Ford demanded the video's release: 'I want everyone to see my condition in that recording.' Ford's associate Sandro Lisi, identified as both friend and driver, faces extortion charges related to retrieving a recording. Police confirmed the video will be used in court proceedings.

'Byl jsem zvolen, abych sloužil, a v tom budu pokračovat,' prohlásil Ford na tiskové konferenci. 'V naší demokracii ať občané příští rok v říjnu rozhodnou sami.' Ford přiznal užití crack kokainu v roce 2013 během 'opilecké epizody,' ale popřel závislost. 'Ztrapnil jsem město a hluboce toho lituji,' uvedl s tím, že 'k podobným chybám už nikdy nedojde.' Tlak zesílil po prohlášení policejního šéfa Williama Blaira o existenci videa údajně zachycujícího Forda s crackovou dýmkou. Městský radní John Filion, který navrhl omezení starostových pravomocí, reagoval: 'Starosta by měl odstoupit a přehodnotit své priority.' article_content: By Vicki Owen. Published: 17:11 EST, 14 December 2013 | Updated: 17:11 EST, 14 December 2013. When James and Emily Bradshaw committed to exclusively purchasing British products in January 2013, they anticipated Christmas would present unique challenges. While sourcing toys for their three-year-old son Lucan and finding UK-made tinsel proved difficult, the unexpected hurdle was British-made matches. 'England's Glory matches with Union Flag packaging are now produced in Sweden,' observed James, a former lawyer from Westerham, Kent. Their year-long experiment revealed economic insights: 'Purchasing seasonal British produce and preserving it often costs less than imports,' Emily noted. Although luxury British clothing remains costly (£350 Welsh jeans), affordable options like East London's £30 dresses exist. The family emphasizes consumer impact, referencing an economist's estimate that £11 extra weekly spending on UK goods could reduce trade deficits. Retailers like John Lewis reported supporting 57% more UK suppliers in 2013. While challenges persist in electronics and staples like rice, successes include Hornby's decision to resume UK production of Airfix models, reversing early-2000s outsourcing. The Bradshaws plan to continue their initiative with adjusted flexibility.

'Zápalky England's Glory s britskou vlajkou se teď dělají ve Švédsku,' prozradil James, bývalý právník z Kentu. Jejich roční projekt odhalil zajímavé skutečnosti: 'Nakupování sezónních potravin a jejich konzervace vyjde často levněji než dovoz,' vysvětlila Emily. I když britské džíny z Walesu stojí 350 liber, našli jsme i levné varianty – třeba šaty z Londýna za 30 liber. Podle ekonomů by utrácení o 11 liber týdně navíc za britské zboží mohlo během roku snížit obchodní deficit. Řetězec John Lewis loni zvýšil počet britských dodavatelů o 57 %.
